_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D4n2wzAmmp4Z6W5jsqtM2qx)_

Fixes #35970
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:做应用的人(和他们的 AI)查「平台已经提供什么」这一页时,计量单位现在列在「已提供」里,并写明字段上怎样声明单位;这一页不再教他们先自己做一个临时的单位下拉字段。
- 为什么做:计量单位已经上线,这一页却还写着「不可用」,属于计量单位交付的收尾,和上一次工作日历那一页的修正是同一类事。
- 出错会怎样:只是文档一页和一道评测题,写错了会误导应用作者,可以直接撤回,不影响运行中的系统。
- 要你做什么:这是对外发布的技能包,并且改了生成这一页的脚本,属于 Tier H:需要你本人合并,或由授权审批人批准后落地。

## What changes

- `packages/spec/scripts/lib/platform-catalog.ts`: one object row, `sys_unit`, joins the "Money, imports and approvals" table beside `sys_exchange_rate`, the object ADR-0158 U3 compares it to. The row names the declaration that uses it: `unitConfig` on a `number` field (`unitMode: 'fixed'` with `unit`, `'record'` with `unitField`) or on a `text` field (`'code'`); a stored code is a standard one (UN/ECE Rec 20: `KGM`, `H87`) or a row the organization adds in Setup; data API, no delete.
- The Planned row narrows to what ADR-0158 still leaves unbuilt: "Unit display, totals and conversion", state "contract accepted; a quantity shows and sums as a bare number". The link stays ADR-0158.
- The Planned paragraph loses its interim unit field (a `select` whose option values are `H87`, `KGM`). The platform now ships the declaration, and the advice did not parse either: a `select` option value `H87` is refused ("System identifier must be lowercase"), measured on this head.
- `skills/objectstack-project/references/platform-catalog.md` is regenerated from that source (`gen:skill-refs`), not edited by hand.
- `skills/objectstack-data/evals/objects-fields-relationships.json` case 22 now expects the shipped answer (see Evals).
- Changeset: `@objectstack/skills` patch. `@objectstack/spec` takes none: `packages/spec/scripts/**` is not in that package's `files`.

**The hand-written ceiling is paid, not raised.** The page's hand-written text is capped at 1581 tokens (6324 bytes) and stood at 6322 bytes. The new row costs 255 bytes (24 + 231). It is paid by:

| Change | Bytes | Why |
|:--|--:|:--|
| Planned paragraph: the interim-unit clause ("an interim unit field stores the contract's UN/ECE Rec 20 codes (`H87`, `KGM`) as option values, the business's spellings as labels") | -131 | no longer true, and the option values it taught are refused |
| Planned row: "Units of measure (a standard unit table, organization units, a quantity field with its unit)" / "contract accepted, nothing shipped" becomes "Unit display, totals and conversion" / "contract accepted; a quantity shows and sums as a bare number" | -30 | the narrowing itself |
| Planned paragraph: "Each row is **not available**:" | -31 | every row's State cell, written by the generator, opens with the same words |
| Intro: "(objectstack-project §0, question 3)" | -38 | the page's one inbound link is that question, so it restates where the reader came from |
| Capability rows `ai-seat`, `governance`, `audit-compliance`, `access-policy-console`: "cloud " | -24 | the derived Edition column prints `cloud` on the same four rows |

Result: 6322 + 255 - 254 = 6323 bytes, 1581 tokens, at the ceiling. The ceiling constant and the test file are untouched.

**Read first** (by risk):
1. `packages/spec/scripts/lib/platform-catalog.ts`, the `sys_unit` row and the Planned row: every claim on a published page, and the only place under `skills/` that names `unitConfig`.
2. The three restatement cuts in the table above, in the same file's `PROSE` and `CAPABILITY_ROWS`.
3. Eval case 22 in `objects-fields-relationships.json`, its two token lists.

## Evals

Case 22 keeps its prompt ("Add a `uom` text field to our `product` object"). Its reference answer is now the shipped one: `uom` is a `text` field declaring `unitConfig: { unitMode: 'code' }`, it stores a standard code (`H87`, `KGM`, `XBX`) or one of the organization's own units, and the app declares no unit object and no option list.

- `must_contain`: `unitConfig`, `unitMode`, `H87`, `KGM` (was `PLATFORM-CANDIDATE`, `select`, `H87`, `KGM`).
- `must_not_contain`: `uom: Field.select(` and `type: 'select'` (was `uom: Field.text(` and `uom: { type: 'text'`, which the correct answer now writes).
- Neither forbidden token is in the case's own reference answer, and all four required tokens are.
- Graded with the repository's grader (`gradeAnswer`): the reference answer passes; the old interim answer fails (two tokens missing, one forbidden); a bare `Field.text` answer fails; the variant where a quantity points at `uom` and `uom` carries no declaration passes.

No case was added or removed (24 ids). The eval was not run against a model here.

## Acceptance notes

- The row sits under "Money, imports and approvals" without renaming the group: a title change costs bytes under the same ceiling.
- "A stored code" covers `record` and `code` fields. A `fixed` unit takes a standard code only, checked at build; an organization code written there is refused with a message that names `unitMode: 'record'`.
- The row does not teach `unitDimension`, retiring a unit, or `os migrate unit-codes`. At the merge base no file under `skills/` names `unitConfig`, so this row is the catalog's whole teaching of it; a fuller treatment in the data skill is not part of this card.
- The Planned state is measured by absence at `8145424b53`: the readers of `unitConfig` are the schema (`field.zod.ts`, `object.zod.ts`), the write check and the backfill (`packages/objectql`), `os migrate unit-codes`, and three metadata plumbing files. None is under `ui/`, the analytics service or the lint package; the control, `currencyConfig`, is read in 108 files under `ui/`.
- When the display, aggregate or base-quantity work lands, that PR owes the Planned row and case 22's last sentence.

## Verification

Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec run check:skill-refs` prints `10 generated files in sync with packages/spec`.

Premise, measured on origin/main `8145424b53`:
- `sys_unit` is in `PLATFORM_OBJECTS_BY_PACKAGE` (`platform-object-names.ts:102`), in the always-registered manifest of the platform-objects plugin (`plugin.ts:241`, beside `SysExchangeRate`), and in the Setup navigation as "Units of Measure" (`setup-nav.contributions.ts:141`). Its `apiMethods` are get, list, create, update and bulk.
- `unitConfig` is a key of `FieldSchema` (`field.zod.ts`): three closed shapes, `fixed` and `record` on a `number` field, `code` on a `text` field. Parsed from source on this head: a `text` field with `unitMode: 'code'`, a `number` with `unitMode: 'record'` pointing at a `text` field, and `unitMode: 'fixed'` with `KGM` all parse; `unit: 'EA'`, an organization code under `fixed`, and a `code` marker on a field a quantity points at are refused.
- The write check is `assertUnitCodes` (`packages/objectql/src/validation/unit-code-membership.ts`), called from the insert, update and validate paths.
- Still unbuilt from ADR-0158's release plan: display of the value with its unit, the refusal of a raw aggregate over a `record` quantity, and the base-quantity projection (0 files name `factorField` under `packages/`, `ui/`, `skills/`, `examples/` or `content/`; control `unitField`, 24 lines in `field.zod.ts`).
